inspection_observations: Footings: the freelancer uses the schedule size for every type (F 0.8 x 0.9 x 0.3 = 0.216). Counts: F 4, F3 1 (source shows two separately drawn F3 outlines), F10 1 at the schedule size, FN 4.
Straps: STB1 0.5 x 0.7 x 4.55, STB2 0.5 x 1.0 x 2.3, STB3 0.4 x 0.5 x 3.25 - lengths within 0.3 % of Urban's measured clear lengths.
Columns: neck height 1.5 m (assumed), GF 3.75 m, 1F / roof 3.45 m = floor-to-floor (4.50 / 4.20) minus 0.75 m (main-beam depth).
Beams: one length per occurrence row, full depth D (no slab deduction); continuous-beam lengths differ from the schedule spans by -6.4 % to +12.1 %.
Slabs: one area per floor, thickness 0.16 (roof part 0.18), no void / beam deduction shown.
Rebar: tonnage typed as constants per group (5.8 / 9.75 / 7.95 / 9.89 / 5.4 / 3.9 / 1.5 t = 44.19 t), ratios 75-200 kg/m3: an allowance, not a bar schedule.
Rooms: reception + dining (+ saloon) is ONE manual row of 137.5 m2; GF master bedroom 16.66 m2; entrance hall 10.46 m2 as its own room.
Aluminium: two GF pool windows 6.57 x 4.3 and 6.33 x 4.3 (the salon width is 6.33; the manual height is 4.30 m, not 3.65); 1F pool window 3.15 x 3.0.

Arithmetic: 1F beam subtotal I82 = SUM(I60:I78) skips I59 (0.128 m3) while the carried value I79 includes it; blockwork H74 multiplies D75 instead of D74 (same value, no numeric effect); pool sheet D19 = #REF!.
15_disagreements_with_chatgpt_plan: The web-app is not just 'derived': its quantities are procurement-rounded (+0.4 % to +8 %) and several categories are lump sums, so it cannot even serve as a rounded copy of the freelancer quantity for comparison - category mapping only.

Footing 'type-by-type concrete' comparison adds nothing beyond counts: both sides use the schedule size, so every footing difference is a COUNT / IDENTITY difference; percentages on per-type volumes would only restate counts.

Salon / reception / dining: the manual merges them into one 137.5 m2 row (and includes the entrance as a separate room), so a room-by-room comparison of that zone is impossible; it can only show what the manual assumed about closure.

Master-bedroom curved glazing: the manual has no curved item; attributing the 6.57 x 4.3 'pool window' to it is itself an identity inference and must be graded MEDIUM, not used to choose Urban's curve basis.
The manual BOQ needs auditing before any Urban difference is called an Urban error: the marble-stair total already double-counts the yard (151.8 m2), and one beam subtotal omits a row.

A single 'foundation concrete' comparison is misleading even after decomposition, because the manual 'footings' total (77.63) silently includes the perimeter strap (8.60) and the straps; only the occurrence-level rows are comparable.
plan: Hash manifest + dependency record (no quantity read before hashing).
Raw extraction of every non-empty row (cell refs, Arabic text, values, formulas; xls values only); web-app rows from the PDF text layer (NFKC-normalised, raw kept).
Normalised model (taxonomy + original description + original unit) by declarative rules (sheet + section + label), no value is changed.
Comparability gate, then metrics for EXACT_COMPARABLE only; difference register with a primary class; manual BOQ QA; backlog P0-P4; owner questions.
B1 freeze, registers twice (byte-identical), one full suite, package (31 md + 16 json + xlsx). No engine change.
